NAME
  dcgm-exporter - Generates GPU metrics in the prometheus format

USAGE
  dcgm-exporter [GLOBAL OPTIONS]
  dcgm-exporter [GLOBAL OPTIONS] COMMAND

COMMANDS
  config
    Inspect settings without starting the exporter
  help, h
    Show help for a command or topic

CONFIGURATION OPTIONS
  --config-file PATH
    Read startup configuration from YAML PATH. Legacy flags and environment
    variables explicitly set on startup override YAML values.
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_CONFIG_FILE

DEVICES AND HOSTENGINE OPTIONS
  --cpu-devices, -p SELECTOR
    Select CPUs and CPU cores using SELECTOR (see device selectors below).
    Default: "f"
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_CPU_DEVICES_STR

  --remote-hostengine-info, -r ADDRESS
    Connect to remote hostengine at ADDRESS (<HOST>:<PORT> or a DCGM URI)
    (tcp://<HOST>:<PORT>, unix:///<SOCKET_PATH>, vsock://<CID>:<PORT>). For
    IPv6, use "[<IPv6_ADDR>]:<PORT>" (e.g., "[::1]:5555")
    Default: "localhost:5555"
    Environment: DCGM_REMOTE_HOSTENGINE_INFO

  --devices, -d SELECTOR
    Select GPUs and MIG GPU instances using SELECTOR; i is unavailable unless
    MIG mode is enabled.
    Default: "f"
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_DEVICES_STR

  --switch-devices, -s SELECTOR
    Select switches and links using SELECTOR (see device selectors below).
    Default: "f"
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_OTHER_DEVICES_STR

  --fake-gpus
    Accept GPUs that are fake, for testing purposes only
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_USE_FAKE_GPUS

  --enable-gpu-bind-unbind-watch
    Enable watching for GPU bind/unbind events to trigger automatic reloads
    (requires DCGM 4.5+)
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_ENABLE_GPU_BIND_UNBIND_WATCH

  --gpu-bind-unbind-poll-interval DURATION
    Poll GPU bind/unbind events every DURATION (DCGM recommends 1s).
    Default: "1s"
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_GPU_BIND_UNBIND_POLL_INTERVAL

  --dcgm-cleanup-timeout DURATION
    Wait up to DURATION for DCGM to release watches; if DCGM has not finished by
    then, the exporter exits.
    Default: 5m0s
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_DCGM_CLEANUP_TIMEOUT

DIAGNOSTICS OPTIONS
  --debug
    Enable debug output
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_DEBUG

  --enable-dcgm-log
    Enable writing DCGM logs to standard output (stdout). Embedded hostengine
    only; not valid with --remote-hostengine-info.
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_ENABLE_DCGM_LOG

  --dcgm-log-level LEVEL
    DCGM log verbosity LEVEL. This parameter is effective only when the
    '--enable-dcgm-log' option is set to 'true'. Possible values: NONE, FATAL,
    ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG and VERB
    Default: "NONE"
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_DCGM_LOG_LEVEL

  --log-format FORMAT
    Log output FORMAT. Possible values: text, json
    Default: "text"
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_LOG_FORMAT

  --dump-enabled
    Enable file-based debugging dumps for troubleshooting
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_DUMP_ENABLED

  --dump-directory DIRECTORY
    Store debug dump files in DIRECTORY
    Default: "/tmp/dcgm-exporter-debug"
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_DUMP_DIRECTORY

  --dump-retention HOURS
    Retain debug dump files for HOURS (0 = no age cleanup; the size and count
    limits still apply)
    Default: 24
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_DUMP_RETENTION

  --dump-compression
    Use gzip compression for debug dump files
    Default: true
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_DUMP_COMPRESSION

  --dump-min-interval DURATION
    Write at most one debug dump per DURATION for each dump kind and entity
    group
    Default: "1m0s"
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_DUMP_MIN_INTERVAL

  --dump-max-file-bytes BYTES
    Limit each debug dump file to BYTES on disk
    Default: 16777216
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_DUMP_MAX_FILE_BYTES

  --dump-max-total-bytes BYTES
    Limit all debug dump files to BYTES in total; the oldest files are removed
    first
    Default: 268435456
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_DUMP_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES

  --dump-max-files COUNT
    Keep at most COUNT debug dump files; the oldest files are removed first
    Default: 128
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_DUMP_MAX_FILES

  --disable-startup-validate
    Disable validation checks during startup. Can be useful for running in
    minimal environments or testing
    Default: false
    Environment: DISABLE_STARTUP_VALIDATE

GENERAL OPTIONS
  --daemon
    Start dcgm-exporter in the background in a new session and exit. Not for
    containers or service managers, which expect the process to stay in the
    foreground.
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_DAEMON

  --daemon-log-file VALUE
    File that receives the output of the background process started by --daemon.
    The output is discarded when empty.
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_DAEMON_LOG_FILE

  --help, -h
    Show help
    Default: false

  --version, -v
    print the version
    Default: false

HTTP SERVER OPTIONS
  --address, -a ADDRESS
    Listen on ADDRESS (<HOST>:<PORT>). For IPv6, use "[<IPv6_ADDR>]:<PORT>"
    (e.g., "[::]:9400")
    Default: ":9400"
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_LISTEN

  --web-read-timeout DURATION
    Maximum DURATION for reading an HTTP request.
    Default: "10s"
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_WEB_READ_TIMEOUT

  --web-write-timeout DURATION
    Maximum DURATION for generating and writing an HTTP response.
    Default: "30s"
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_WEB_WRITE_TIMEOUT

  --max-concurrent-scrapes COUNT
    Admit up to COUNT concurrent scrape requests. Excess requests receive HTTP
    503 while admitted overlapping requests are coalesced.
    Default: 16
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_MAX_CONCURRENT_SCRAPES

  --web-config-file PATH
    Web config file PATH following the exporter-toolkit spec:
    https://github.com/prometheus/exporter-toolkit/blob/master/docs/web-configuration.md.
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_WEB_CONFIG_FILE

  --enable-pprof
    Enable /debug/pprof/ HTTP endpoints on the metrics port; needs a web config
    file with TLS or basic auth
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_ENABLE_PPROF

  --web-systemd-socket
    Use systemd socket activation listeners instead of port listeners (Linux
    only).
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_SYSTEMD_SOCKET

METRICS OPTIONS
  --collectors, -f PATH
    Read DCGM metric definitions from CSV PATH
    Default: "/etc/dcgm-exporter/default-counters.csv"
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_COLLECTORS

  --enable-exporter-metrics
    Expose Go runtime, process, and HTTP handler metrics about dcgm-exporter
    itself.
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_ENABLE_EXPORTER_METRICS

  --collect-interval, -c MILLISECONDS
    Collect metrics every MILLISECONDS.
    Default: 30000
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_INTERVAL

  --watch-max-keep-age DURATION
    Maximum DURATION of samples retained by DCGM field watches. Set to 0s to
    disable the age limit when a sample limit is configured.
    Default: 10m0s
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_WATCH_MAX_KEEP_AGE

  --watch-max-keep-samples COUNT
    Retain up to COUNT samples in DCGM field watches. Set to 0 for no
    sample-count limit when an age limit is configured.
    Default: 0
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_WATCH_MAX_KEEP_SAMPLES

  --use-old-namespace, -o
    Use old 1.x namespace.
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_USE_OLD_NAMESPACE

  --configmap-data, -m NAMESPACE:NAME
    Read metrics from ConfigMap NAMESPACE:NAME. Deprecated: still supported;
    mount the ConfigMap as a file and pass its path with --collectors instead.
    Default: "none"
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_CONFIGMAP_DATA

  --no-hostname, -n
    Omit the hostname information from the output, matching older versions.
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_NO_HOSTNAME

  --xid-count-window-size, -x MILLISECONDS
    Window MILLISECONDS for counting sampled XID error observations in
    DCGM_EXP_XID_ERRORS_COUNT. Must be greater than 0.
    Default: 300000
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_XID_COUNT_WINDOW_SIZE

  --replace-blanks-in-model-name, --rbmn
    Replace every blank space in the GPU model name with a dash, ensuring a
    continuous, space-free identifier.
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_REPLACE_BLANKS_IN_MODEL_NAME

  --clock-events-count-window-size MILLISECONDS
    Window MILLISECONDS for counting sampled clock-event observations in
    DCGM_EXP_CLOCK_EVENTS_COUNT. Must be greater than 0.
    Default: 300000
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_CLOCK_EVENTS_COUNT_WINDOW_SIZE

WORKLOAD LABELS OPTIONS
  --kubernetes, -k
    Enable kubernetes mapping metrics to kubernetes pods
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_KUBERNETES

  --kubernetes-enable-pod-labels
    Enable kubernetes pod labels in metrics. This parameter is effective only
    when the '--kubernetes' option is set to 'true'.
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_KUBERNETES_ENABLE_POD_LABELS

  --kubernetes-enable-pod-uid
    Enable kubernetes pod UID in metrics. This parameter is effective only when
    the '--kubernetes' option is set to 'true'.
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_KUBERNETES_ENABLE_POD_UID

  --kubernetes-gpu-id-type TYPE
    Map Kubernetes resources to pods using GPU ID TYPE. Possible values: 'uid',
    'device-name'
    Default: "uid"
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_KUBERNETES_GPU_ID_TYPE

  --kubernetes-pod-label-allowlist-regex PATTERN
    Include pod labels matching regex PATTERN (comma-separated). Required when
    pod labels are enabled; use .* to include all labels. This parameter is
    effective only when '--kubernetes-enable-pod-labels' is true.
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_KUBERNETES_POD_LABEL_ALLOWLIST_REGEX
    May be repeated; comma-separated values are accepted.

  --pod-resources-kubelet-socket PATH
    Kubelet pod-resources socket PATH.
    Default: "/var/lib/kubelet/pod-resources/kubelet.sock"
    Environment: DCGM_POD_RESOURCES_KUBELET_SOCKET

  --hpc-job-mapping-dir DIRECTORY
    Read GPU to job mapping files from DIRECTORY.
    Environment: DCGM_HPC_JOB_MAPPING_DIR

  --hpc-job-mapping-max-file-bytes BYTES
    Ignore an HPC job mapping file larger than BYTES.
    Default: 65536
    Environment: DCGM_HPC_JOB_MAPPING_MAX_FILE_BYTES

  --hpc-job-mapping-max-job-id-bytes BYTES
    Ignore an HPC job mapping file with a job ID longer than BYTES.
    Default: 256
    Environment: DCGM_HPC_JOB_MAPPING_MAX_JOB_ID_BYTES

  --hpc-job-mapping-max-jobs-per-file COUNT
    Ignore an HPC job mapping file with more than COUNT distinct jobs.
    Default: 64
    Environment: DCGM_HPC_JOB_MAPPING_MAX_JOBS_PER_FILE

  --container-labels
    Enable runtime container labels in metrics.
    Default: false
    Environment: DCGM_EXPORTER_CONTAINER_LABELS

  --container-runtime-socket PATH
    Container runtime socket PATH used for container labels. Empty means
    /var/run/docker.sock when container labels are on.
    Environment: DCGM_CONTAINER_RUNTIME_SOCKET

  --nvidia-resource-names NAME
    GPU resource NAME values such as nvidia.com/a100, nvidia.com/a10.
    Environment: NVIDIA_RESOURCE_NAMES
    May be repeated; comma-separated values are accepted.

  --kubernetes-virtual-gpus
    Capture metrics associated with virtual GPUs exposed by Kubernetes device
    plugins when using GPU sharing strategies, e.g. time-sharing or MPS.
    Default: false
    Environment: KUBERNETES_VIRTUAL_GPUS

  --kubernetes-enable-dra
    Capture metrics associated with GPUs managed by Kubernetes Dynamic Resource
    Allocation (DRA) API.
    Default: false
    Environment: KUBERNETES_ENABLE_DRA

VERSION
  test

DEVICE SELECTORS
  Use f alone, g or i, or g+i. Add :0,2-4 to g or i for indexed selection.
  GPU: g selects GPUs; i selects MIG GPU instances and requires MIG mode.
  GPU f selects each GPU's MIG instances when present, otherwise the GPU.
  CPU: g selects CPUs; i selects CPU cores; f selects both.
  Switch: g selects switches; i selects links; f selects both.
  f cannot be combined or indexed. Device indices are checked at runtime.
